finding: With the approved 4 GiB vLLM direct-CUPTI bound, all 200 warmup and 2200 measured requests completed, but the helper did not acknowledge STOP within the approved 30 seconds. Its roughly 2.9 GiB trace remained partial, no CUPTI status was written, and the run exited 1. The captured requests are not valid final evidence.

proposed_change.scope: vLLM direct-CUPTI stop acknowledgment wait only
proposed_change.order: After all measured requests and the measurement end marker are persisted, send STOP while the server and GPU worker remain alive; wait up to 300 seconds per helper for an explicit acknowledgment and finalized trace/status, verify those artifacts and loss counters, then shut down the server.
proposed_change.rationale: The existing 30-second wait expired during finalization of a roughly 2.9 GiB compressed trace. A longer bounded wait permits CUPTI flush and trace fsync without accepting missing acknowledgments. Whether 300 seconds is sufficient is unverified and must be checked on hardware before final trials.
proposed_change.failure_rule: Timeout, missing status, missing terminal frame, nonzero exits, count mismatch, or reported loss remains partial or failed. Retain the partial trace and every command, log, timestamp, and status. Do not count a timed-out preflight as a final repetition.
proposed_change.measurement_and_cost: The stop wait follows the approved measured request window and does not change its workload or latency population. Record its elapsed time and paid runtime separately.

required_validation_before_final_observa: focused CPU tests for the 300-second per-process wait and unchanged timeout/failure preservation
one isolated full-workload L4 capacity preflight with the approved 4 GiB bound and the longer stop wait
require 2400 request rows, stop ACK, finalized per-process trace/status, terminal frame, decoded counts, and zero drops
download and verify all raw evidence before pausing the one paid instance
complete trusted Nsight coverage and remaining operational hardware gates
